meta.reset: Reset DB, cache and search index to `fixtures` before every case. Seed fixtures.languages first, then fixtures.editors: one object per translation (slug, lang, name, bio, deleted_at). deleted_at is shared per slug, so every row of a slug repeats the same value (null = active); the loader should assert that rows of one slug agree. Actor rows are seeded by the harness; inject sessions directly. This module needs no bulk fixture: clamping is observed through status codes.
meta.actor: Key into fixtures.actors, or: anonymous, garbage_session, expired_session. Actor caps are per entity: caps.editors = [create, edit, delete]; root also holds caps.languages = [create, delete] for the cross-system cases. Listing, reading and searching need only a valid session.
meta.language: Body and response field is `lang`. POST/PATCH/search send a fallback language in the Content-Language header (used when body lang is empty, null or missing); GET routes send Accept-Language. DELETE needs neither. Language management lives under /cms/languages and is assumed to keep the {name, code} body of the former locales routes.
meta.limits: 2 MiB (2097152 bytes) on every route except DELETE, which keeps 4 KiB. 413 above the limit. Size is measured in wire bytes.
meta.request: path_params are unescaped and must be percent-encoded when substituted. headers: null removes a default header. A request with a body carries Content-Type: application/json unless overridden. body_generator {json_padded_bytes: N, base} = valid JSON of exactly N bytes, padded with an unknown field. {$repeat: {s, n}} expands to s repeated n times.
meta.json_assertions: ops used: type, eq, len_eq, len_lte, gte, includes, excludes, sorted_asc, sorted_desc, is_null.
meta.eventually_ms: Retry the step until it passes or the timeout elapses (search indexing is async).
meta.source: documented = rules inside the source_document; stated = rules you gave outside it (413, 415, 2097153, 401, null -> zero value, bio any string); inferred = derived from conventions or from the earlier modules' tests.
meta.null_handling: null decodes to the Go zero value. Search: query '', sort_by '', page and count -> defaults, deleted false, deleted_after/before 0 (no filter), lang -> header fallback. Create: name and bio '', lang -> header fallback; slug null is an empty slug and fails. Update: null/omitted fields are ignored.
meta.soft_delete: DELETE sets deleted_at (shared by every translation). GET one and list still return the editor with deleted_at; active editors omit the field. Assumed: update, rename, new translations and a second delete return 404; the slug stays taken (create and rename-to-it return 409).
meta.tags: boundary, cache, security, regression, undocumented_limit, cross_system (touches /cms/languages), verify_normalisation, verify_slug_rules, verify_name_rules (editor names assumed to follow the category name rules), verify_printable, verify_bio_rules (bio stored verbatim incl. whitespace and control characters), verify_deleted_at_shape (omitted vs null when active), verify_deleted_filter (zero-value `deleted` means no filter), verify_deleted_visibility (list and GET include deleted editors), verify_zero_filter (deleted_after/before = 0 means no filter), verify_soft_delete, verify_list_shape (list and search items omit bio), verify_locale_precedence, verify_locale_validation, verify_content_language, verify_accept_language, verify_patch_new_translation, verify_patch_empty, verify_patch_create_perm, verify_patch_conflict, verify_noop, verify_cascade, verify_sortable (name and slug sortable; bio, lang not), verify_clamp, verify_doc_typo (count defaults to 1), verify_reserved_slug, verify_bodiless, verify_check_order.
meta.not_covered: Binding users to editors ('editor rights'): the doc describes it but lists no route. Concurrency.
